subject: Request: Q4 reserve window for high-throughput pilot
messages:
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: dev_patel@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, evelyn_hart@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-12T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Q4 reserve window for high-throughput pilot

Team —

Quick heads-up: Noventis (prospect) asked to run a 6-week pilot starting 2026-11-02 that will target sustained low-latency inference for a batch of internal ML workflows. They want predictable throughput for two 4-hour windows each weekday (US mornings) and have asked for reserved GPUs during those slots.

High level numbers from yesterday's scoping with Peter:
- Peak concurrent tokens: ~1.2M tokens/hour during test windows
- Expected latency SLO: p95 < 300ms for generation calls (chat flows)
- Pilot duration: 6 weeks (Nov 2 — Dec 14)

Ask: can we provision a temporary reservation (or a scoped autoscale-exemption) that pins N GPU instances to a dedicated pool during the requested windows? We need SRE/Product input on feasibility, cost estimate, and any rollbacks/guardrails. I attached the SLA doc we shared with the customer and exported the HubSpot deal for context.

If this can be done, I need an approval note for the commercial proposal by EOD 2026-10-15 so we can include the reservation costs in the pilot contract.

Thanks —
Karthik
Karhtik Iyer
Sales Lead, Applied & Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: pilot_SLA_requirements.pdf, hubspot-deal-export.csv

From: dev_patel@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: evelyn_hart@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-12T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Q4 reserve window for high-throughput pilot

Karthik —

Thanks for the context. A few quick clarifying Qs so we size this properly:
1) Are the customer windows contiguous each day (e.g., 08:00–12:00) or two distinct short bursts? You said two 4-hour windows — are they fixed or flexible?
2) What model(s) will they request for the pilot? Different checkpoints change memory/slot sizing (we need an estimate: Llama-2-70B/quantized vs. open-vendors).
3) Do we need GPU isolation (dedicated pool) or would a priority-backed autoscale policy suffice (reserved minimum replicas + pre-warmed nodes)?

Feasibility notes:
- We can do a timeboxed reservation in Dedicated for a 6-week window, but it requires finance commit + capacity scheduling. Lead time is 7–10 business days to adjust physical pool allocations if we need extra GPUs in a region.
- Autoscale exemption (policy override) is lower friction: we set a minimum replica floor in their route and add pre-warmed nodes during the windows. This avoids hard isolation but provides predictable throughput.

I'll baseline three options and ballpark costs per week once you confirm model and window times. If they need strict data isolation for audit reasons, call that out — it changes the recommendation.

— Dev
Dev Patel
SRE / Capacity Planning
Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: dev_patel@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: evelyn_hart@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-13T08:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Q4 reserve window for high-throughput pilot

Folks —

Spoke with Peter this morning. Confirming the two windows are fixed: 09:00–13:00 PST and 15:00–19:00 PST weekdays. They will primarily run a tuned 32k context chat model (customer-provided weights based on a 70B architecture, likely to map to our 70B quantized profile).

Important compliance note from the customer: they want tenant-level isolation for the pilot (no shared best-effort pools) due to IP concerns. They also requested weekly usage reporting and access to token-level cost breakdowns for the pilot.

From a CS perspective, we're ok with a scoped reservation if Product/SRE can confirm performance and the cost estimates are reasonable. Also need a rollback plan if errors exceed 2% of requests in a day.

— Laura
Laura Bennett
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

From: evelyn_hart@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-14T14:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Q4 reserve window for high-throughput pilot

Team —

After reviewing capacity and the upcoming Q4 commitments, we can approve a timeboxed dedicated reservation with the following constraints:
- Reservation window: 2026-11-02 to 2026-12-14
- Daily slots: 09:00–13:00 PST and 15:00–19:00 PST (weekdays only)
- Pool size: 6 x A100-80GB-equivalent GPUs (configured as a dedicated logical pool for the deal)
- Cost multiplier: standard Dedicated reserved-rate + 20% short-term premium (to account for reallocation friction)
- Rollback trigger: automated rollback to priority-backed autoscale if request error rate > 2% for two consecutive hours OR average latency p95 > 600ms for 3 consecutive intervals

Action items for each owner:
- Dev (SRE): prepare the pool config, automated rollback playbook, and pre-warm scripts. Target completion: 2026-10-26.
- Product (Laura): confirm the model mapping and alerting thresholds with the ML lead at Noventis.
- Sales (Karthik): update the commercial summary with this reservation cost and get legal sign-off for the SLA addendum.

I will also schedule the reservation in our internal capacity calendar once Dev confirms physical availability.

— Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Capacity Program Manager
Redwood Inference
